_about: ONE list of the bundles the ERP ships with, read by BOTH hosts: the page (plugin_overlay.js _builtins) and the door (common/door/door_plugins.js startBuiltins). Paths are relative to erp/. 'builtin' = installed and STARTED once, like the bundles of a default OSGi distribution (bim-compiler prompts/ERP_FRIENDLY_OPS_LENS.md §27). 'installOnly' = installed, NOT started: legacy ships these in the stack with nothing reachable until an admin switches them on (Plugins & Releases -> Enable). Change the list here only.
